entries.en: Add support for enterprise managed settings. Contact your Anthropic account team to enable this feature.
entries.zh: 添加对企业托管设置的支持。请联系您的 Anthropic 客户团队以启用此功能。

entries.en: Improved plan mode exit UX: show simplified yes/no dialog when exiting with empty or missing plan instead of throwing an error
entries.zh: 改进计划模式退出体验：计划为空或缺失时，显示简化的是/否对话框，而不是报错

entries.en: Fixed IME (Input Method Editor) support for languages like Chinese, Japanese, and Korean by correctly positioning the composition window at the cursor
entries.zh: 通过将合成窗口正确定位在光标处，修复了 IME（输入法编辑器）对中文、日语和韩语等语言的支持

entries.en: Fixed a bug where disallowed MCP tools were visible to the model
entries.zh: 修复了模型可以看到不允许的 MCP 工具的错误

entries.en: Fixed an issue where steering messages could be lost while a subagent is working
entries.zh: 修复了子代理工作时转向消息可能丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Option+Arrow word navigation treating entire CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) text sequences as a single word instead of navigating by word boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了选项+箭头单词导航将整个 CJK（中文、日语、韩语）文本序列视为单个单词，而不是按单词边界导航
